assessment.label: Situation
assessment.text: Whoville has lost electricity and heating. The team has reviewed the distribution dashboard and recovered SCADA log screenshot.

assessment.label: New findings
assessment.text: Inject 3 is available and the leader is working on it. Its contents and implications have not yet been analyzed in this lead chat. Earlier reviewed findings remain the Inject 1/2 baseline.

assessment.label: Leading hypotheses
assessment.text: Unauthorized account or privilege misuse and authorized maintenance remain alternatives. Monitoring faults, equipment failure, and other blackout causes remain open. A cyberattack is not established.

assessment.label: Contradictions
assessment.text: Dashboard table and footer counts disagree; some OFFLINE readings show flow. Recovery/restart timing needs aligned clocks. A source reread supports PID 2189 and a backup path without a leading slash; underlying text is still needed.

assessment.label: Recommended action
assessment.text: Review Inject 3, correlate it with the existing evidence and timeline, and revise the presentation draft where supported. Existing response recommendations remain proposals awaiting leader approval.

assessment.label: Critical unknowns
assessment.text: Blackout cause, authorized activity, source clocks, physical grid state, official deadline and time zone, judging rubric, and presentation requirements.
